meta.answer: Basic has a $0 monthly fee and no minimum balance. It does have charges for some services: out-of-network ATM withdrawals cost $2.50 each, foreign transactions cost 3%, card replacement costs $5, and expedited card shipping costs $25. Basic also has no overdraft fees; transactions that would overdraw your account are declined instead.
Premium costs $15.00 per month and includes a metal debit card. [plan-premium]
Your upgrade takes effect immediately. You’ll be charged Premium’s full monthly fee today, and today becomes your new billing date.

If this is your first paid plan and you were charged less than 14 days ago, leaving the paid plan gets you a full refund of that charge. The help-center excerpt doesn’t include the steps for leaving the plan.

If your balance is too low on your billing date, Tallowbrook tries to collect the plan fee again after 3 days. If that attempt also fails, your plan moves to Basic. Cushion doesn’t cover plan fees; you can return to a paid plan after adding money.
No. Monthly plan fees aren’t eligible for goodwill refunds; they have a separate cooling-off rule. Outside that period, plan fees aren’t refunded or prorated.
Yes. Plus now costs $5.00 a month; it used to cost $4.00 a month before the March 1, 2026 fee update.
You get 3 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month on Plus. After that, each withdrawal costs $2.50. [atm-fees-plus-v2]
Premium has no Tallowbrook fee for using another bank’s ATM in the US. The ATM owner may charge a surcharge, and Premium reimburses up to $10 per calendar month.
On Basic, replacing your card costs $5. Standard shipping is free; expedited shipping costs an additional $25, for $30 total with expedited shipping.
No, the replacement card itself is free on Plus, and standard shipping is free. Expedited shipping costs $25 if you choose it.

The Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount in US dollars. It applies to purchases in foreign currency and US-dollar purchases processed by merchants outside the US; it doesn’t apply to ATM withdrawals abroad.

No. The foreign transaction fee applies to purchases, not ATM withdrawals abroad. International ATM fees apply instead: $3 on Basic and Plus, and free on Premium; the ATM owner may also charge a surcharge.
Sending a domestic wire costs $25 on Basic, $15 on Plus, and is free on Premium.
No. International wires aren’t available to send on the Basic plan; you can still receive them. Sending international wires is available on Plus and Premium.
Incoming domestic wires are free on every plan. Incoming international wires cost $10 on Basic and Plus, and are free on Premium.
Cash deposits at a store cost $3 per deposit on the Plus plan.
Tallowbrook doesn’t charge fees for returned transfers or for inactivity, on any plan. Your other bank may charge a fee for a returned transfer.

Support can’t refund a second fee as a goodwill refund within a rolling 12-month period. If the ATM fee was charged in error, though, it can still be refunded; error refunds don’t count toward the goodwill limit.

Correct: Premium has a $0.00 out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee. The ATM owner may still charge a separate surcharge; Premium reimburses those surcharges up to $10 per calendar month, automatically on the first business day of the next month. Check whether the charge is labeled “Out-of-network ATM fee” or is an ATM-owner surcharge. [fees-all-v2] [atm-surcharges]
Daily card spending limits are $3,000 on Basic, $5,000 on Plus, and $10,000 on Premium.

Open the app, tap **Cards**, then **Activate card**. Scan your new card or enter its last four digits and expiry date, then set your PIN when prompted; activation is instant. Make sure you’re activating the newest card, since an old or replaced card can’t be activated.

If it was a standard card and it’s been 10 business days since it was mailed, message support in the app. They’ll cancel the card in transit and send a replacement at no fee. Check the app for the date it was mailed.
Standard card delivery takes 7 to 10 business days. Business days exclude weekends and bank holidays.

Freezing is temporary and reversible: it immediately blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals, and you can unfreeze the card in the app. Reporting it lost or stolen cancels it permanently and can’t be undone; you can then order a replacement. If you think you may find the card, freeze it first.
Yes. Freezing your card does not stop recurring payments to merchants you’ve already authorized, such as Netflix. To stop future charges, cancel with Netflix directly.

Freeze the card in the app by tapping Cards and switching on Freeze card. If you can’t find it, tap Report lost or stolen to cancel it permanently; then you can add a virtual card and order a replacement in the app. You can also check your transactions and dispute anything you don’t recognize.

Yes. Every verified member can create one virtual card in the app, and it works right away for online purchases and in mobile wallets while your replacement is on its way. It has its own card number and can be used independently of your physical card.
No. Reporting the card as damaged doesn’t cancel it; you can keep using it if it still works until you activate the replacement. Activating the new card switches the old one off.
We mail your renewal card automatically about 30 days before your current card expires. It keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code.
In the app, tap **Cards**, choose your card, then **Controls**. Switch off **International purchases**; the change takes effect straight away.

“Locked by Tallowbrook” means a fraud lock, not a freeze, so the freeze toggle can’t remove it. If there’s a fraud alert in the app, respond to it; if not, message support in the app so your case can be passed to the Fraud team. The Fraud team replies within 2 business days, often sooner.
No. Your metal card keeps working until it expires. After it expires, or if you need a replacement, you’ll get a plastic card.

Cards are sent to the address on file. Update your address before ordering the replacement; a card that’s already been mailed can’t be redirected. You can update your address in the app, and support is available there if you need help.
On Basic, the replacement card costs $5. Standard shipping is free and takes 7 to 10 business days.
In the app, tap **Cash**, then **ATM map** to see nearby BrookLink ATMs and their opening hours.
No. Support can’t raise your ATM limit, even for one day. Basic has a $500 daily limit across all ATMs; getting a higher limit requires changing plans.

If the withdrawal is still pending, wait until it posts—you can’t dispute it while pending. If it has posted, open the transaction in the app, tap **Get help**, then **Cash not dispensed** to dispute it within 60 days. Keep the ATM location, date and time, and any receipt; if the records show the cash wasn’t dispensed, we credit the full amount, including any ATM fee we charged for that withdrawal.
No. BrookLink ATMs don’t accept cash deposits; use a participating retail store to add cash instead.

These are separate charges: the ATM owner sets its surcharge, while Tallowbrook may charge an out-of-network fee shown as a separate line in your activity. On Basic, and on Plus after your free withdrawals, that fee is $2.50; it’s free on Premium. BrookLink ATMs have neither charge.
Premium reimburses ATM-owner surcharges up to $10 per month. The reimbursement is credited automatically on the first business day of the following month.

No. Tallowbrook no longer requires travel notices and has retired the Travel mode setting. Before you go, make sure International purchases is switched on under Cards, then Controls, and keep app notifications on for fraud alerts.

We convert foreign-currency purchases to US dollars using the card network’s exchange rate on the day the transaction settles, with no added markup. The rate can differ slightly from the one shown while the purchase is pending.

The pending amount is an estimate using the exchange rate from when you paid. Once the purchase settles, it’s converted using the card network’s rate on the settlement day, usually a day or two later, so the posted amount can change. Your plan’s foreign transaction fee may also apply.

Yes. As a Premium member, you can get an emergency card sent to your address in Japan; it costs $0 and usually arrives within 3 business days, though remote areas may take longer. Freeze or report your card in the app, then message support with the full address where you’ll be staying.

No. Your card works in most countries where Visa is accepted, but purchases, ATM withdrawals, and online orders from comprehensively sanctioned countries and regions are declined. International purchases must also be switched on in your card controls for foreign merchants to accept the card.
No, you don’t need to tell us before traveling. Plus has a 1% foreign transaction fee on purchases abroad. [travel-notice-v2] [fees-schedule-plus-v2]
ACH transfers submitted before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day. Transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, on weekends, or on bank holidays are sent the next business day.

In the app, tap Transfers → Linked accounts → Add account, choose your bank, and sign in to link it instantly. If your bank isn’t listed, enter its routing and account number; after two small deposits arrive in 1–2 business days, enter both amounts in the app within 14 days to finish linking. The external account must be in your name.

The help center excerpts don’t say whether a link remains active if you haven’t confirmed the two test deposits, or what happens after three weeks. The help center doesn’t cover this; please contact support in the app.

No. An external bank account must be in your name, so you can’t link your wife’s account—even if she is your spouse. You can each have your own Tallowbrook account and send money to each other instantly for free with BrookPay.

No. BrookPay payments can’t be cancelled or reversed, even by support. Ask the recipient to send the money back; if you think it was a scam, report it to us right away, though recovery isn’t guaranteed.
Yes. You can cancel a scheduled ACH transfer in the app any time before 4:00 PM ET on its send date. After the cutoff, it’s already on its way and can’t be cancelled.
For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, transfers above $500 are blocked. This applies to BrookPay and external transfers too; the limit ends automatically, and support can’t remove it early.
No. A wire can’t be cancelled once it has been sent. We can ask the receiving bank to return the money, but the bank decides and a return isn’t guaranteed.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Direct deposit → Set up automatically**, then find your employer or payroll provider and sign in. Or, download the pre-filled form from that screen or copy your routing and account numbers and give them to your employer. The switch usually takes one or two pay cycles, and your first paycheck may still go to your old account.

You can get your paycheck up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday. The timing depends on when your employer sends the payroll file, so you might be paid one day early or on payday instead; early direct deposit is automatic and included on every plan at no cost.
On Plus, you can deposit up to $2,500 in mobile checks per day.

After a check deposit is accepted, the first $225 is available the next business day, and the rest is available within 2 business days. If your account has been open less than 30 days, we may hold the deposit for up to 7 business days; other longer holds may apply in certain cases. The app shows your deposit’s release date.
Sign the back of the check, then write “For mobile deposit only at Tallowbrook” under your signature. [check-deposit-how]
No. ACH transfers only process on business days, so a transfer submitted on Saturday is sent the next business day.
The Premium monthly ACH transfer-out limit is $50,000 per calendar month. It resets on the first day of each calendar month at midnight Eastern Time.
No. Basic ACH transfers out are limited to $2,500 per day, so a $4,000 ACH transfer today exceeds the daily limit.
No. If your balance is too low on the send date, the recurring transfer is skipped and isn’t retried. There’s no fee, and future transfers in the series will still run.

Give the sender your routing number, account number, full legal name, and address. For an international wire, they also need Tallowbrook’s SWIFT code; you can find these in the app under Account details → Wire instructions.

Freeze the card used, or report it lost or stolen, before opening an unauthorized dispute. Report the charge within 60 days of the date of the statement it first appeared on; if it’s still pending, wait until it posts before disputing it.
For a jacket you paid for but never received, file a merchant dispute within 120 days. Contact the merchant first and keep a record of your messages and their response.

You may be able to dispute the card purchase with the merchant. The help center doesn’t say whether a broken item qualifies or guarantee a refund; see “Disputing a purchase with a merchant” for details.

If your dispute passes the initial review, you’ll get a provisional credit within 10 business days. Most disputes finish within 45 days, and some take up to 90 days; the credit is permanent if your dispute is resolved in your favor.
No. We send you a written explanation first, then take the provisional credit back 5 business days after that notice. If that makes your balance negative, you’ll need to add money.
No. You can’t dispute a transaction while it’s pending; wait until it posts, then the Dispute option will appear when you tap it. Most pending transactions post or drop off within 7 days.

The pending hotel charge is likely a temporary authorization; it usually drops off within 7 days and can’t be disputed while pending. If both charges post, contact the hotel first; if it doesn’t help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate within 120 days of the transaction date.

Report the unauthorized ACH debit within 60 days of the statement where it first appeared. In the app, tap the transaction, choose “Get help,” then “I didn’t authorize this.” If your claim passes an initial review, you’ll receive a provisional credit within 10 business days while the company’s bank is asked to return the money.
No. Support can open disputes totaling up to $5,000 per case; a $7,200 dispute goes to the Disputes team, who will contact you within 2 business days.

Upload the order confirmation showing the expected delivery date, any tracking information, and messages you sent the merchant asking about delivery. You can add photos or PDFs under Profile > Disputes > Add documents.
Withdraw the dispute from its case page if the merchant refunded you directly, so you aren’t credited twice. If you were credited twice, contact support.

No. That’s a scam: Tallowbrook will never ask you to read out a one-time code. Hang up and open the app yourself to contact support; if you shared the code, change your password right away and message support.
If you don’t respond within 24 hours, your card stays locked until you contact Tallowbrook. You can answer the alert in the app; if there’s no alert, message support in the app.
The one-time sign-in code is valid for 10 minutes. Keep it to yourself—Tallowbrook will never ask you to read it out.

The reset link expires after one hour. If it has expired, start again by tapping “Forgot password” on the sign-in screen and requesting a new link. Open the link on the same phone and confirm the one-time code we text you.

If someone makes an unauthorized card transaction, you’re not responsible if you report it within 60 days of the statement it first appears on. Freeze your card or report it lost or stolen before opening an unauthorized dispute; reporting it lost or stolen cancels it permanently. [disputes-unauthorized] [card-lost-stolen-v2]
No. Tallowbrook’s fraud-alert texts only ask you to reply YES or NO and never contain a link. Don’t click it; open the Tallowbrook app to check the alert. [security-fraud-alerts]

No. Tallowbrook charges no overdraft or nonsufficient-funds fees on any plan. If a transaction would overdraw your account, it’s generally declined with no fee, though a balance can rarely go negative in certain situations.
On Premium, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $200 below zero, with no fee.

You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days, and Cushion must be available on your plan: Plus or Premium. You can turn it on in the app under Profile, then Cushion; Basic doesn’t include Cushion.
No. Cushion covers debit card purchases only; ATM withdrawals are not covered.

There’s no fee or interest for leaving a Cushion balance unpaid. After 30 days, Cushion is suspended until you’re back at zero and meet the direct deposit requirement again; after 60 days, your account is restricted, though you can still add money, until the balance is repaid.
On Premium, Savings Pockets earn 3.75% APY on combined balances up to $100,000; amounts above that earn 0.10% APY. Your main balance doesn’t earn interest.
Plus Savings Pockets earn 2.00% APY on combined balances up to $100,000; any amount above that earns 0.10% APY. Interest compounds daily and is paid monthly.
Your Basic Savings Pockets now earn 0.50% APY. The rate changed on June 1, 2026.
Savings interest is paid once a month, on the first business day of the following month, and appears as “Interest.”
You can have up to 10 Savings Pockets, each with its own name and goal.
No. There’s no limit on how many times you can withdraw from a Savings Pocket, and moving money to your main balance is instant and free.
If you earned less than $10.00 in interest last year, Tallowbrook won’t send a Form 1099-INT. Your interest will still appear on your monthly statements, and you may still need to report it.
Yes. We email members at least 30 days before lowering a savings rate.

In the app, tap **Profile**, then **Close account**. You’ll need to have no pending transactions or open disputes and a non-negative balance; move money out of Savings Pockets and switch your direct deposit and automatic payments first. Support can also close it if your balance is $0.00 and those requirements are met.

If you have a linked external account in your own name, Tallowbrook sends your remaining balance there by ACH. Otherwise, it mails a check to the address on your profile; either way, it’s sent within 10 business days of closing.
No. Closed accounts can’t be reopened; you can apply for a new account in the app. If Tallowbrook closed your account, you may not be able to open a new one.

We may close your account if it has a $0 balance and no activity for 12 months. We’ll email you at least 30 days beforehand, and any activity during that notice period keeps it open. We don’t close accounts for inactivity if they still have money, including in Savings Pockets.
No. Plus plan fees aren’t refunded or prorated when you close your account, including for the month you close it.
Phone support is available every day from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET.
We acknowledge formal complaints within 2 business days and send a final response within 15 business days. If we need more time, we’ll explain why and tell you when to expect an answer.

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Power of attorney,” or ask your mom to message support from her session. Send a signed, in-effect power of attorney document, your government-issued photo ID, and your contact details; Account Services will confirm receipt within 2 business days and may request more information. You can’t access account information or give instructions until they approve the document.

I’m sorry for your loss. Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Bereavement,” or message support; the Account Services team will handle the case. They’ll ask for the death certificate, proof that you’re the executor or administrator of the estate or next of kin, and your photo ID.

Card refunds usually show in your account within 5 to 10 business days after the merchant issues them, so 3 days is still within the usual timeframe. Some refunds appear as pending first; the money is available once the refund posts.

Support can freeze or unfreeze your card, report it lost or stolen and order a replacement, open eligible disputes up to $5,000, refund fees under the refund policy, change your plan, close an account when the balance is zero and nothing is pending or disputed, and explain fees, limits, and policies. Fraud, disputes above the support limit, verification issues, power of attorney or deceased-account matters, and formal complaints go to specialist teams, which reply within 2 business days. Support can’t raise limits, act for someone other than the account holder, or open disputes after their window.

If it’s safe, message support in the app and say someone is pressuring you to hand over your money. They’ll pass your case to the trained Account Services team, and they won’t tell anyone else you contacted them. If you’re in immediate danger, call emergency services first.

You must be at least 18, live in the US with a US residential address (not a PO box), and have a Social Security number or ITIN, an unexpired government-issued photo ID, and a smartphone that can run the Tallowbrook app. Download the app, tap Get started, and enter your details, take a photo of your ID, and take a selfie.
Most applications are verified within 1 business day, and many within minutes. If your application needs manual review, it can take up to 5 business days.
You can try up to 3 times, so after failing twice, you have 1 try left. After the third unsuccessful attempt, your application will be closed and you can apply again after 30 days.
Yes. You can still receive deposits while your account is under review, including your paycheck by direct deposit. Depending on the review, some other account features may be unavailable.

If Tallowbrook can’t confirm your address automatically, you may be asked for a utility bill, lease or mortgage statement, bank or credit card statement, or government letter showing your name and new address. The document must be dated within the last 90 days.
Message support if you’ve lost access to your old phone number. They’ll pass your request to the team that verifies your identity, which can take longer.
Your monthly statement is ready within 3 after the month ends, and we’ll notify you when it’s available.
No. Tallowbrook offers individual accounts only, not joint accounts. You and your partner can each open your own account and send money to each other instantly for free with BrookPay.
No. Tallowbrook only offers personal accounts, not business accounts. [products-business]
No. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investing or brokerage accounts, and you can’t buy, sell, or hold cryptocurrency with us.

When a new friend opens a Tallowbrook account using your invite link and receives at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days, you both get $25. Each bonus is paid within 5 business days after your friend qualifies. Find your link under Profile → Invite friends; it must be used when they sign up, and it can’t be added afterward.
No. Reporting the card stolen cancels it permanently, even if you find it later, so you can’t keep using it. Freeze it instead if you’re only trying to temporarily secure a card you might find.
No. A damaged-card replacement keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code. Some merchants that store your card may need the new expiry date, so check your subscriptions.
The help center can’t recommend stocks or give investment advice. Tallowbrook also doesn’t offer investment or brokerage accounts.
The help center can’t advise you on how to report freelance income on your taxes. Please speak with a tax professional.
The help center doesn’t cover the current federal funds rate.

I can’t advise whether Bitcoin is a good investment or when to invest. Tallowbrook’s support team can explain its products, but for advice about your situation, speak with a qualified financial adviser.
The Tallowbrook help center doesn’t cover recommendations for travel rewards credit cards.
The help center doesn’t cover translating a landlord’s letter into Spanish.

Tallowbrook can’t advise on how to raise your credit score. A Tallowbrook account won’t raise or lower your score, and Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit products or report your account to credit bureaus.
The help center doesn’t cover DMV hours.
The help center doesn’t provide tax accountant recommendations. For advice about your situation, it suggests talking to a qualified tax professional.
The help center doesn’t cover whether renting or buying a house is smarter. For advice about your situation, it recommends speaking with a qualified financial adviser.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer personal loans, so there’s no interest rate to provide.
International wires aren’t available to send on the Basic plan, so there’s no sending fee. Basic members can still receive international wires, which cost $10.00.
Cushion isn’t available on Basic, so there’s no Cushion limit. Debit card purchases that would overdraw your account are declined, with no fee.

We don’t charge inactivity fees on any plan. You may be seeing a paid plan’s monthly fee, which continues while your account is open and isn’t prorated. Check your activity feed for “Plan fee” and the plan name.
Plus includes a plastic card, not a metal one. Upgrade to Premium if you want a metal card; the app will ask whether you want it now or at your next renewal.
BrookPay is free on every plan, so there’s no fee for sending more than $1,000. Your daily BrookPay limit depends on your plan: $1,000 on Basic, $2,500 on Plus, and $5,000 on Premium.
Not necessarily—the current merchant-dispute window is 120 days, not 90 days. An order you paid for but never received qualifies, so at 100 days it may still be within the window.

No. The current Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount in US dollars. It applies to foreign-currency purchases and US-dollar purchases processed by a merchant outside the US; ATM withdrawals abroad have a separate international ATM fee.

No. Early direct deposit can make your paycheck available up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday, depending on when the employer sends the payroll file. It’s included on every plan at no cost.

Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit cards; your Tallowbrook card is a debit card that spends money already in your account. If you mean moving money from another bank, link that external account first to transfer between it and Tallowbrook.
You can deposit cash at participating retail stores, but the help center excerpt doesn’t name specific stores.
The help center doesn’t say how many BrookLink ATMs are in Ohio. You can see nearby BrookLink ATMs in the app by tapping Cash, then ATM map.
Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received and may ask for more information. The help center doesn’t specify how long approval itself takes.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can choose a custom design for your Premium metal card.
The help center doesn’t specify a cap on how many friends you can refer. It says each qualifying friend earns you and your friend $25.00.
The help center excerpts don’t say what the Premium savings APY was in 2024, so I can’t confirm it.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can set a spending limit just for restaurant purchases. It says card controls don’t change your limits, but doesn’t specify restaurant-specific controls.

After Account Services confirms who is authorized, the balance is paid to the estate. The help center doesn’t specify how long that payment takes; Account Services contacts you within 2 business days.
The help center doesn’t provide a direct phone number for the Fraud team. Use the contact details in the Tallowbrook app or help center; scammers may post fake support numbers online.
The help center doesn’t say whether statements are available in Spanish.
